questions.question: A quantity is a vector when it:
options: Is measured in newtons
Has a very large magnitude
Needs both a magnitude and a direction to be fully described
Is always positive

questions.question: The dependable classification test asks:
options: Is a direction needed to complete the quantity's meaning?
Does the quantity have an SI unit?
Is the quantity used in mechanics?
Is the number measured with an instrument?

questions.question: Why must vectors and scalars use different arithmetic?
options: Vectors always use bigger numbers
Vectors can strengthen, partly cancel or fully cancel each other depending on direction
Scalars cannot be added at all
They do not — everything adds the same way

subtopics.title: Classifying the Five — and the Famous Pairs

questions.question: Which grouping of the five quantities is correct?
options: Vectors: speed, energy; scalars: displacement, force, velocity
Vectors: displacement, energy; scalars: speed, force, velocity
All five are scalars
Vectors: displacement, force, velocity; scalars: speed, energy

questions.question: You jog once around a 600 m loop, ending at your starting gate. Distance and displacement are:
options: Distance 600 m; displacement zero, because start and finish coincide
Both 600 m
Distance zero; displacement 600 m
Both zero

questions.question: That 600 m loop took 150 s. Average speed and average velocity are:
options: Both 4 m/s
Speed 4 m/s; velocity zero, because displacement was zero
Speed zero; velocity 4 m/s
Both zero

questions.question: Velocity is best defined as:
options: Distance covered per unit time
The scalar partner of speed
The rate of change of position — speed with its direction attached
Force divided by mass

subtopics.title: The Resultant — 40 N East Meets 70 N West

questions.question: Taking east as positive, 40 N east and 70 N west become:
options: +40 N and +70 N
−40 N and +70 N
−40 N and −70 N
+40 N and −70 N

questions.question: The resultant of 40 N east and 70 N west is:
options: 30 N west
110 N west
30 N east
110 N east

questions.question: Why is '110 N' the classic wrong answer for these two forces?
options: The unit should be kilonewtons
It adds the magnitudes with scalar arithmetic, ignoring that the forces oppose each other
It forgets to halve the answer
It is actually the correct answer

questions.question: Which pair of sanity checks confirms '30 N west'?
options: The resultant must be zero, and forces always cancel
The resultant equals the smaller force and points east
The resultant points with the larger force, and its magnitude is the difference 70 N − 40 N
No checks exist for vector answers

subtopics.title: The Toolkit, the Special Cases, and the Road to Matric

questions.question: The four-step method for adding vectors along a line is:
options: Declare a positive direction; rewrite each vector as a signed number; add algebraically; translate the final sign back into a direction
Add all magnitudes, then choose the majority direction
Average the forces and double the result
Draw every vector to scale and measure with a protractor only

questions.question: Forces of 70 N east and 70 N west act on a trolley. The resultant is:
options: 140 N east
70 N west
Zero — the forces balance completely
35 N east

questions.question: Adding magnitudes directly gives the correct resultant only when:
options: The forces are measured in newtons
All the vectors point in the same direction
The object is heavy
There are exactly two forces

questions.question: A complete final answer to a vector problem must state:
options: Only the magnitude with units
Only the direction
The sign convention instead of a direction
Both the magnitude with units AND the direction

questions.question: Which statement is already complete, needing no direction?
options: A shove of 40 N on a stuck gate
An airtime voucher costs thirty rand
A journey of 2 km from the taxi rank
A velocity of 80 km/h

questions.question: The sentence test on 'six hundred joules of energy southward' shows that energy is:
options: A vector, because energy sounds mighty
A vector, because joules are large units
A scalar, because the direction adds nothing to the meaning
Impossible to classify

questions.question: A speed becomes a velocity the moment:
options: A direction of travel is attached to it
It exceeds 100 km/h
It is converted to metres per second
It is measured by a speed camera

questions.question: You jog once around a 600 m block and stop at your own gate. Distance and displacement are:
options: 600 m and 600 m
Zero and 600 m
1200 m and zero
600 m and zero

questions.question: Distance and displacement can disagree because:
options: Distance asks how much moving happened; displacement asks what the moving achieved
Displacement uses different units from distance
Distance is a vector and displacement is a scalar
One of the two measurements must be an error

questions.question: The 600 m loop took 150 seconds. The average velocity is:
options: 4 m/s
0 m/s, because the displacement was zero

questions.question: Jogging the same 600 m dead straight south in 150 s instead would give:
options: Distance zero, displacement 600 m south
Distance 600 m, displacement 600 m south, velocity 4 m/s south
Distance 600 m, displacement zero
Speed zero, velocity zero

questions.question: In the tug-of-war picture, why is the answer 30 N rather than 110 N?
options: Because the rope absorbs the extra force
Because forces weaken over time
Because 40 N of the stronger team's pull is used up cancelling the weaker team, leaving 30 N spare
Because the measurement of 110 N was faulty

questions.question: 'Declare a positive direction' means:
options: Choose a direction, call it positive, and keep that choice until the final line
Always make north the positive direction
Write every force as a positive number
Reserve positive signs for the largest force

questions.question: Forces of 40 N east and 70 N east act on the same crate. The resultant is:
options: 30 N east
30 N west
Zero
110 N east

questions.question: Why is 'thirty newtons' only half an answer?
options: Because the number should be seventy
Because a vector answer needs its direction too — 30 N west
Because forces must be written in words
Because the unit is missing
